headline: Eyes on the fund investigation and the CMB! Borsa at its lowest level in the last 6 months
summary: Borsa Istanbul opened the week with intensifying selling pressure. The BIST 100 index fell below 12,500 points, a loss of more than 3%, to its lowest level in six months.
why: The BIST 100 is Turkey's benchmark stock index, reflecting the performance of its largest listed companies.

impacts.name: BIST 100
impacts.why: Selling pressure pushed the BIST 100 down more than 3% to its lowest level in six months.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The input links the sell-off to the ongoing fund investigation and the capital markets regulator, which weighed on sentiment at the open.
